title: AI in Plannerly: How It Works and What You Control

AI in Plannerly

# AI on your terms

AI in Plannerly is there when it helps and never required. Every job works without it, you check what it writes, and your projects aren't used to train AI models. Coming soon: switching AI off for a company or project, bringing your own AI, and Javis.

[Start free](https://app.plannerly.com/sign-up) [How we protect your data](https://plannerly.com/security/)

Free plan, no card. Everyone you invite joins free.

Your terms

## What you can count on, and what's next

### Every job works without AI

Write, import, plan and check by hand whenever you prefer. AI is a shortcut you can take, never a step you have to.

### You check what AI writes

Rewrites wait for your OK, imports show you a preview before anything is created, and what AI adds to a document stays in its history, so you can undo it.

### Not used to train AI

Your projects, documents and files aren't used to train AI models - not by Plannerly, and not by the AI providers it uses.

### Your data, in your region

On the Company plan, choose where your projects are stored: the EU, the US or Canada.

[Security and data residency](https://plannerly.com/security/)

[**What our terms say about AI** \\
Your team reviews and approves what AI produces before relying on it - our terms say so plainly.](https://plannerly.com/terms/) [**Ask about the Company plan** \\
Choose your data region, require single sign-on, and have us complete your security questionnaire.](https://plannerly.com/quote/)

### Switch AI off for your company or a project

You'll be able to turn AI off for your whole company or for one project, so it only runs where you want it.

Coming soon

### Bring your own AI

You'll be able to connect the AI your company has approved, such as Claude or ChatGPT, through Plannerly MCP. It will see only what you can see in Plannerly.

Coming soon

### Ask Javis, the project assistant

Javis will answer your questions about the project. It will only read, see only what you can see, and only work when someone asks it.

Coming soon

Javis, the project assistant

## Coming soon: ask Javis about your project

### It will only read

Javis will read your project to answer your questions. It won't change, add or delete anything in it - to keep or share an answer, you'll save it yourself.

Coming soon

### It will see what you can see

Javis will work with your own project permissions and check them again before every answer, so it never shows you anything you couldn't open yourself.

Coming soon

### It will answer when you ask

Javis will only work when someone asks it a question. It won't act on its own.

Coming soon

## Every job, with AI or without it

[**Start the BEP from the EIR (AI can draft it)** \\
Bring the client's EIR in, start from the ISO 19650 template and answer each requirement yourself - or let AI draft a first answer for you to check.\\
BEP](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/eir-to-bep-ai/) [**Write any project document** \\
Start from a template or import your Word file, then write each section yourself or let AI draft a first version for you to edit.\\
Docs](https://plannerly.com/plan/) [**Build the scope from your spreadsheet** \\
Add the rows yourself, or let Import with AI read your Excel, CSV, PDF or Word file - you check the preview before anything is created.\\
Scope](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/scope-at-scale/) [**Set the information requirements** \\
Write them from the templates or your library, or let AI enrich and standardise them. You review everything before it's issued.\\
Requirements](https://plannerly.com/use-cases/information-requirements/) [**Check every model, every time** \\
No AI here: the rules you set check every linked model version automatically, the same way every time.\\

No AI here either: every task has an owner and a date, and Plannerly sends the reminders before it's due.\\

Questions

## Questions about AI in Plannerly

Do we have to use AI in Plannerly?

No. Every job works without it: write documents yourself or from the templates, import your Word files or add scope rows by hand, and the model checks and reminders don't use AI at all. AI is there when it saves you time. [See how Docs works](https://plannerly.com/plan/).

Can we switch AI off for our company or a project?

That's coming soon: you'll be able to turn AI off for your whole company or for one project. Until then, every job works without it, so nobody has to use AI to get their work done.

Does anything AI writes go in without someone checking it?

You stay in charge of what it writes. In Docs, rewrites such as Correct, Expand and Simplify wait for you to confirm them. Write my section and Summarize add their text to the section you asked about, and the document's version history keeps the before and after, so you can undo it. Import with AI shows you what it found before anything is created. Our [terms](https://plannerly.com/terms/) say the same: your team reviews and approves what AI produces before relying on it.

Is our data used to train AI models?

No. Plannerly doesn't train AI models on your projects, documents or files, and the AI providers it uses don't train theirs on them either. [How we protect your data](https://plannerly.com/security/).

Where is our data stored?

In the region your company chooses: the European Union, the United States or Canada. Each region runs on its own systems, with its own databases and file storage, so your projects are never stored with another region's. Choosing your region is part of the Company plan. [Ask about the Company plan](https://plannerly.com/quote/).

Can we use our own AI with Plannerly?

That's coming soon: you'll be able to connect the AI your company has approved, such as Claude or ChatGPT, through Plannerly MCP. It will sign in as you, so it will see only what you can see in Plannerly.

What will Javis be able to see?

Only what you can. Javis, coming soon, will work with your own project permissions and check them again before every answer. It will only read, it won't change anything in your project, and it will only work when someone asks it a question.

Is AI included in the Free plan?

Yes. The Free plan includes an AI allowance, and Pro adds more. You never have to use it. [See pricing](https://plannerly.com/pricing/).

## Try Plannerly with AI, or without it

Start free, pick one job, and decide for yourself where AI saves you time.
